caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with an upholstered seat. The chair features curved legs and a rounded backrest, both of which are adorned with intricate carved floral designs. The wood is shaded in varying tones of light to medium brown, giving depth and dimension to the carvings and structure. The seat is padded and covered with a muted green fabric, accented along its edge by a subtle decorative trim. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present. The composition centers the chair, with all four legs, the seat, and the full backrest clearly visible. The artist's signature, "Stewart," appears in small letters at the lower right corner.
title: Carved Side Chair
